decisions.reason: After two years the modest web presence weakens the case, but as a close, likely low-cost custom hearing accessory it still seems worth keeping as an option while demand becomes clearer.
Its own page and tight fit with the firm's core custom hearing offering suggest a viable product whose option value remains high and carrying cost relatively low.

The thermoforming unit supports the firm's integrated equipment workflow, and although hardware is costlier to support than accessories, the firm is likely to keep learning from market uptake rather than exit now.

This orthopedic product is the weakest strategic fit and thus the riskiest option, but because it was only launched in 2024 and has a dedicated page the firm would likely give the adjacent diversification bet more time.
As a very recent, close-in post-curing unit linked to digital production, it is still an early-stage option that likely costs little enough to retain while adoption information accumulates.
